narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The angles double each time, so the next ones are one hundred twenty and two hundred forty.
<bookmark mark='skip'/>Turn the wheel by three steps of sixty degrees, and it also fits there.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Doubling skips that turn. Add one step at a time, and the bubble is struck.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, count the steps you added to reach the full turn.
<bookmark mark='full'/>Six steps of sixty degrees make three hundred sixty degrees. That is one full turn.
